result.topic_en: Drawings of algebraic curves on squared paper: on the left a looped curve through a multiple point with petal-like branches, auxiliary circles and marked construction points; on the right a symmetric curve with four hyperbola-like branches arranged about perpendicular axes inside a large circle, together with asymptote-like straight lines.
result.transcription:
[faint pencil annotations at top left, largely illegible; small numbers along a scale line]
[left figure: curve with lobes meeting at a central point, construction points marked]
[right figure: four symmetric branches about horizontal and vertical axes within a circle, with straight lines crossing the branches]
